
  ▲ vercel flags [command]

  Manage feature flags for a Vercel project                                     

  Commands:

  list                       List all feature flags for the current project
                             (default)                                     
  inspect      flag          Display information about a feature flag      
  versions                   List and compare version history for a feature
                             flag                                          
  evaluations  [flag]        Display evaluation metrics for a feature flag,
                             or for every flag in the project when no flag 
                             is given                                      
  create       slug          Create a new feature flag                     
  open         [flag]        Open feature flags in the Vercel dashboard    
  update       flag          Update an existing feature flag               
  set          flag          Set the served variant for a feature flag in  
                             an environment                                
  targeting                  Manage targeting for a feature flag           
                             environment                                   
  split        flag          Configure a weighted split for a feature flag 
                             in an environment                             
  rollout      flag          Configure a progressive rollout for a feature 
                             flag in an environment                        
  delete       flag          Delete a feature flag                         
  archive      flag          Archive a feature flag                        
  unarchive    flag          Unarchive a feature flag                      
  disable      flag          Shortcut to serve the false variant of a      
                             boolean feature flag in an environment        
  enable       flag          Shortcut to serve the true variant of a       
                             boolean feature flag in an environment        
  rules                      Manage conditional rules for feature flags    
  targets                    Manage direct targets: entity values that     
                             always receive a fixed variant                
  segments                   Manage feature flag segments                  
  entities                   Manage the entity schema used for flag        
                             targeting                                     
  labels                     Discover label lists and manage labels for    
                             string or stringArray attributes              
  sdk-keys                   Manage SDK keys for feature flags             
  prepare                    Prepare flag definition fallbacks for the     
                             build                                         
  datafile                   Display the datafile of the project           
  override     [flag=value]  Encrypt flag overrides into a secure token for
                             the vercel-flag-overrides cookie              


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number
